note: Round 2 for Thailand: chain menus, the four regional cuisines in depth, individual curries and stir-fries, the noodle and kanom jeen families, street stalls, kanom and drinks. MK Restaurant rows carry MK's own published per-dish calorie figure (mkrestaurant.com); their macros, and everything else here, are worked out from the dish's ingredients and its street portion. Nothing is marked verified because no Thai chain in this round publishes a full macro panel. The 169 dishes already in the catalogue are deliberately absent, including their alternative romanizations.
